InstallExplanation: ExtGuide will keep the extension at the selected location. Windows may request administrator permission for a protected folder.
UpdateExplanation: ExtGuide found an existing installation and will safely replace it at the same location.
DestinationHint: The selected folder will contain an extension-specific child directory.
ChooseBaseFolder: Choose the base folder for the extension
Installing: Downloading, validating, and installing the extension...
AdministratorPermissionExplanation: Windows protects this location. You can request administrator permission for this installation, choose another folder, or cancel.
FinishSubheading: ExtGuide prepared the folder. Chrome requires these final clicks from you.
Step1: 1   Turn on Developer mode inside the green outline in the upper-right corner.
Step2: 2   Choose Load unpacked inside the orange outline in the upper-left area.
Step3: 3   In the folder dialog, focus the location field (Ctrl+L).
Step4: 4   Paste the prepared path (Ctrl+V), then press Enter.
Step5: 5   Confirm the folder if Chrome asks.
UpdateFinishSubheading: ExtGuide updated the existing files at the same location. Chrome must reload them.
UpdateStep1: 1   Find the existing extension card on the Chrome Extensions page.
UpdateStep3: 3   If Reload is hidden, enable Developer mode first.
VisualGuideAccessibleName: Chrome Extensions page showing Developer mode outlined in green and Load unpacked outlined in orange
ChooseChromeHeading: Choose the Chrome installation to open
ValidatedChromeExplanation: Every listed application passed ExtGuide validation.
FailureMessageConfiguration: The extension installation configuration is invalid.
FailureRecoveryConfiguration: Get a fresh installation link. If the problem continues, contact the extension publisher.
FailureMessageNetwork: ExtGuide could not download the files required for installation.
FailureRecoveryNetwork: Check the internet connection and retry. If the problem continues, contact the extension publisher.
FailureMessageIntegrity: The downloaded extension files did not pass security verification.
FailureRecoveryIntegrity: Do not install these files. Download them again and contact the publisher if verification still fails.
FailureMessageDestination: ExtGuide could not use the selected installation location.
FailureRecoveryDestination: Confirm that the folder still exists and is readable and writable. Choose another location or allow administrator permission if needed.
FailureMessageExtraction: The downloaded file is not a complete and valid Chrome extension package.
FailureRecoveryExtraction: Download it again. If it still fails, ask the extension publisher to inspect the release package.
FailureMessageChromeDiscovery: ExtGuide could not find an available Google Chrome installation.
FailureRecoveryChromeDiscovery: Install stable Google Chrome, or choose chrome.exe when prompted.
FailureMessageExecutableValidation: The selected application is not a verified stable Google Chrome installation.
FailureRecoveryExecutableValidation: Choose chrome.exe installed by the official Google Chrome installer.
FailureMessageLaunch: ExtGuide prepared the extension but could not complete the open or copy step.
FailureRecoveryLaunch: Open chrome://extensions manually and use the extension path shown by ExtGuide.
FailureMessagePolicy: An organization policy on this device blocked the operation.
FailureRecoveryPolicy: Contact your administrator. ExtGuide will not bypass organization security policy.
ManagedDeveloperTools: Your organization disables Chrome developer tools. Developer mode may also be restricted.
ManagedExtensions: Your organization blocks extension installation unless an administrator allows it.
